findings.description: The single-file wrapping check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain `str` path is no longer wrapped in a tuple.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling `click.edit(filename="notes.txt")` with a plain string. A str is not os.PathLike, so the branch is skipped and the str is passed to `ed.edit_files(filenames=...)`. edit_files iterates it, so the editor is invoked with individual characters ('n', 'o', 't', ...) as filenames instead of the single file. Impact: the most common single-file form of edit now opens the wrong files or fails, a regression for existing callers.
